description: Every Cardano DEX the site indexes, side by side: volume, swaps, makers (distinct wallets) and trading fees of the last 24 hours with the share of all volume, the same over the last 7 and 30 full days where that many are stored, liquidity (ADA in its pools), number of pools and fee APR (trading fees of 7 full days scaled to a year, over the liquidity in pools that have liquidity providers; null for bonding curves, order books and pools whose fee is unknown). DEX versions are separate entries (Minswap and MinswapV2).
name: list_dexes
title: Cardano DEXes compared
